title: selliguea albicaula
intro: Selliguea albicaula, commonly known as Golden Spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea albicaula include anti-diarrheal, anti-fever, and anti-hemorrhoidal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
